data.content_ref: inline:INTEGRATES: 024cbd0e1e4f integrates with SRC_005 by providing the missing causal explanation that SRC_005 explicitly defers — SRC_005 frames the question as 'by design or by bug?' and proposes a test that documents whichever it is, while 024cbd0e1e4f supplies the mechanism: the three pre-v6 roots were written by a now-removed writer version that attached a legacy manifest schema, and verify_root_report's version check compares against the current manifest schema, classifying schema-mismatch as a verdict (data issue) rather than an error (system issue). The sweep instrument sees the system-issue framing (ERROR), while direct-load sees the data-issue framing (verdict), producing the 11-vs-14 delta. This integrates the observability gap into a concrete data-model evolution narrative. This is REFUTED IF the three pre-v6 roots use the same manifest schema as the 14 raising manifests (no schema difference), or if verify_root_report does not inspect manifest schema at all — the classification difference would then stem from something other than schema evolution.
